mentions.name: SuppValue
mentions.description: This website lets users search for a vitamin, mineral, or supplement and displays products ranked by the most amount of that supplement per dollar. Multivitamins and Omega 3s are handled a little differently, and protein powders are ranked by grams of protein per dollar.
mentions.problem: It was difficult to find the best supplement for the money.
mentions.audience: People looking to find the best-value supplements for use in their personal lives.
mentions.source_excerpt:
At one point I got really annoyed at how difficult it was to find the best supplement for the money, so I built https://suppvalue.com/

It's pretty simple: just search for the vitamin/mineral/supplement you want, and it displays them all ranked by the most amount of that supplement per dollar.
